changesApplied.changeMade: Fixed syntax error: changed 'while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; then' to 'while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do'
changesApplied.reason: Validation harness had bash syntax error preventing execution. while loops require 'do' keyword, not 'then'
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: Critical fix - validation harness can now execute successfully

changesApplied.changeMade: Rebuilt container image with gh CLI installation already present in Dockerfile
changesApplied.reason: Running pods did not have gh CLI installed. Dockerfile had correct installation commands but image needed rebuild and pod restart
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: All 3 pods now have gh CLI installed (verified with gh --version). Non-destructive validation improved from 9/15 to 12/15 passing tests

changesApplied.changeMade: Removed actual API keys and tokens from git-committed file, replaced with empty placeholders and security warnings
changesApplied.reason: HIGH SECURITY RISK: Real Anthropic API key and GitHub token were committed to git in plain text. Credentials exposed in version control history
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: Security vulnerability mitigated. Secrets must now be provided via environment variables or kubectl secret creation (as designed)
changesApplied.securityNote: Actual secrets were: sk-ant-api03-hpwrf... and gho_mcSL9bYdNFJ... - these should be rotated immediately

changesApplied.changeMade: Created new .env.example file documenting proper secret management workflow
changesApplied.reason: Users need clear guidance on how to provide secrets securely without committing to git
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: Developers can now copy .env.example to .env (gitignored) and fill in actual secrets safely

changesApplied.component: Legacy Helm Deployment - Git Environment Variables
changesApplied.changeMade: Added GITHUB_TOKEN, GIT_USER_NAME, GIT_USER_EMAIL environment variables from secrets
changesApplied.reason: Legacy deployment.yaml was missing git environment variables present in k8s-devbob-statefulset.yaml, causing configuration drift
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: If anyone uses this legacy Deployment (instead of StatefulSet), git operations will now work correctly

changesApplied.changeMade: IDENTIFIED but NOT CHANGED: github-token is empty (0 bytes)
changesApplied.reason: GITHUB_TOKEN environment variable not available. Secret exists but value is empty, causing gh CLI authentication to fail
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: 3/15 tests still failing: gh-cli-authenticated on all pods. Git clone/push/PR operations will fail until token is provided
remediationRequired: Option 1: Export GITHUB_TOKEN env var and re-run ./deploy-devbob-k8s-git.sh
Option 2: kubectl create secret generic devbob-secrets --from-literal=github-token=ghp_YOUR_TOKEN --dry-run=client -o yaml | kubectl apply -f -
Option 3: Create .env file with GITHUB_TOKEN and source it before deployment
After token update: kubectl rollout restart statefulset/devbob -n metabob

issues: gh CLI not installed (6 failures across 3 pods)

metabobAnnotations.reason: Bash syntax requires 'do' keyword for while loops, not 'then'. 'then' is only for if statements
metabobAnnotations.designDecision: Used standard bash while-do-case pattern for CLI argument parsing

metabobAnnotations.reason: gh CLI is required for automated PR creation/merging in autonomous git operations. Uses official GitHub CLI APT repository for latest stable version
metabobAnnotations.designDecision: Install at image build time (not runtime) for faster pod startup and smaller attack surface

metabobAnnotations.reason: Secrets must NEVER be committed to git. Placeholder values force users to consciously provide real secrets via secure methods
metabobAnnotations.designDecision: Empty strings as placeholders + prominent security warnings. Secrets provided via environment or external secret management

remainingGaps.gap: GITHUB_TOKEN is empty in Kubernetes secret
remainingGaps.impact: All git push, PR create, PR merge operations will fail authentication
remainingGaps.remediation: User must provide valid GitHub PAT with repo, workflow scopes
